caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular sample of woven fabric with a plaid pattern, composed primarily of three colors: dark blue, red, and off-white. The pattern is made up of alternating horizontal and vertical stripes in these colors, creating a grid of squares and rectangles. The dark blue stripes are the thickest and form a prominent grid that encloses smaller rectangles and squares of red and off-white. Red stripes, thinner than the blue, intersect with both the blue and white areas and are distributed evenly across the fabric. The off-white squares and rectangles appear where the blue and red lines do not overlap, providing a contrast to the darker colors. The weaving texture is visible, showing the interlacing threads of each color. The composition centers the fabric sample within a plain background, with handwritten text in the lower right and upper left corners of the image.
title: Coverlet: Gentleman's Fancy
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
